question: Which office of an organization may add a person to the organization and assign an organization role, may that office grant a role above its own, does the person have to accept before the membership is active, and which offices may read the full roster with contact details and membership numbers?
decision: Org-designated membership officers/admins invite and verify members, but membership activates only after the invitee accepts and the organization verifies eligibility. Granting officer/admin or equivalent privileged roles requires separate approval by a second authorized office-holder; no self-elevation or grant above issuer mandate. Officers may grant member/steward only within their scoped office authority. Full roster identifiers/contact only to authorized membership officers; stewards see their assigned constituency’s work contact; members have no bulk roster access. All grants/revocations audited.
originalProposedDecision: Admins add members and assign roles; officers may add members and grant member or steward. No one grants a role above their own. The person must accept an invitation before the membership is active. Full roster with contacts and membership numbers: officers and admins; stewards see names and work contact of members they represent; members see no roster.
